title: Referrals
subtitle: Every referral from {{facility}}: track acceptance, scheduling and evidenced completion.
overdueHint: Derived from the due date a person set. Overdue is never a stored status.

kpi.label: Referral summary
kpi.overdueHint: Open referrals past their due date
kpi.medianHint: From request to evidenced completion — demo figure

drawer.title: Referral
drawer.description: Status, evidence and history of this referral.
drawer.denied: This referral is outside the facility you are working in. The attempt has been recorded in the audit log.
drawer.notFound: This referral could not be found.
drawer.reviewNoDecision: No decision recorded on this review.
drawer.historyUnavailable: The history could not be loaded. The referral itself is shown above.
drawer.terminal: This referral is closed. No further changes are possible.
drawer.noPermission: Your role cannot change referrals. You can still read this one.
drawer.destinationOnly: This referral was sent to your facility from another facility. Only the referring facility can change it.
drawer.offline: You are offline. Changes are disabled; the referral stays readable.

dialog.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters (spaces do not count).
dialog.failed: Nothing was lost: your entries are kept. Try again — the same request is re-sent, so it cannot be saved twice.

update.acceptBody: Record that {{destination}} has accepted this referral.
update.scheduleBody: Record the appointment date and time agreed with the destination facility.
update.editBody: The previous values stay in the referral history.
update.dueAtHint: Set by you, Africa/Kigali time. No protocol interval is applied.

complete.title: Complete referral with evidence
complete.description: Completion needs the date, the outcome and an approved evidence type with a reference.
complete.notEvidenceNotice: A reminder or message being sent is not evidence of completion.
complete.completedAtHint: When the patient attended (not later than now). Africa/Kigali time.
complete.evidenceReferenceHint: E.g. the register line or return-slip number.
complete.confirmBody: The referral will be closed as completed with this evidence.

cancel.title: Cancel referral
cancel.description: Cancelling closes the referral. A new referral can then be created for the same review.

create.title: Create referral
create.description: For a decided review that has no open referral.
create.reviewHint: Only decided reviews without an open referral are listed (dismissed flags are excluded).
create.noneEligible: There are no decided reviews without an open referral.

conflict.title: This referral changed since you opened it
conflict.body: Someone else saved a newer version. Nothing was overwritten. Reload the latest version and check it before you try again.

errors.alreadyOpen: This review already has an open referral. Only one open referral per review is allowed.
errors.invalidTransition: This change is not possible from the referral's current status.
